metadata.title: Optimal rational spherical designs on the circle
metadata.abstract: The minimum numbers of points in rational equal-weight spherical designs on the circle are $2304$, $4608$, $9216$, and $9216$ at strengths $4$, $5$, $6$, and $7$, respectively. We construct two nonisometric optimal designs at each strength. At arbitrary strength $t$, we obtain an explicit cardinality divisor $D_t$ with $\log D_t=(1/2+o(1))t\log t$. Applied to the antipodal pairs of a $4608$-point design, Gromov's torus construction gives a flat minimal immersion of $\mathbb{T}^2$ into $S^{4607}$ with $2304$ distinct integral frequencies, attaining Petrunin's sharp Euclidean normal-curvature bound.
metadata.comment: 35 pages. Includes exact verification algorithms and construction certificates

analysis.progressType: 圆上最小有理球面设计
analysis.workSummary: 作者给圆上等权有理球面设计在强度4、5、6、7时最小点数依次为2304、4608、9216、9216，各构造两种非等距最优设计。
analysis.breakthrough: 任意强度t给显式基数除数D_t，log D_t=(1/2+o(1))t log t。4608点设计的对踵对给T²到S^4607的平坦极小浸入，达到Petrunin法曲率界。
analysis.limitations: 最小性针对有理等权设计，非一般实点球面设计。精确验证算法和构造证书尚未独立执行。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
